summary: This is a Phase 1 study to test the drug SGB-3403 in healthy volunteers and people with high levels of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol, which is a type of fat in the blood that can build up in arteries. The study aims to look at safety and other measures by giving injections under the skin to 64 participants. The current status of the trial is Unknown status. Suzhou Sanegene Bio Inc. is the sponsor organizing the study.
